objective: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.

description: Now I'm going to up the stakes on you and truly test your skill.  Prove to me you can kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.  If you can do that, you will be ready for your final challenge before I declare you a master tiger hunter in Master Nesingwary's presence.
Elder Stranglethorn Tigers are not only the most difficult to find, they are also the fiercest to defeat.
progress: You must kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers before I give you the final challenge that will determine if you are a true tiger hunting master.
completion: Most impressive.  I believe you are almost ready.
